title: Pineapple Suprise Coleus - 1x Plug Plant - Interesting House Plant Or Ornamental
description:
Coleus ‘Pineapple Surprise’ is an upright, heat-tolerant coleus valued for its striking tricolour foliage: iridescent chartreuse to yellow-green leaves with deep burgundy centres and splashes of green. Bred for season-long colour, very late flowering, and reliable performance in sun or shade. Ideal for borders, patio containers, and mixed planters.


 Key Details:


  Variety: Coleus ‘Pineapple Surprise’ (Premium Sun series)
 

  Quantity: 2 Plug Plants
 

  Type: Annual/ Perennial as a houseplant.
 

  Genus/Species: Solenostemon scutellarioides
 

  Foliage: Chartreuse/yellow with burgundy hearts; stable colour through the season
 

  Height & Spread: Approx. 45–66 cm tall × 46–56 cm wide
 

  Habit: Upright, well-branched; late to flower
 

  Position: Full sun to shade; best colour in bright light. In low humidity, provide afternoon shade
 

  Hardiness: Protect below 10°C
 

 Planting and Care Instructions:


  When to Plant Out: After last frost, when nights are consistently above 10°C
 

  Spacing: 30–41 cm apart
 

  Soil: Average to fertile, well-drained; keep evenly moist, not waterlogged
 

  Feeding: Fertilise every 2–3 weeks in containers, or use a slow-release fertiliser at planting
 

  Care Tips:
  
    Pinch off any bloom spikes to maintain leafy, bushy growth
   

    Water regularly until established; increase frequency in hot weather
   

    Tolerates full sun in humid regions; foliage may scorch in full sun with very low humidity
   

    Deer-resistant; good tolerance to heat and urban conditions
   


 Why Choose ‘Pineapple Surprise’?
 

 A high-impact, low-maintenance coleus with dependable, season-long foliage colour and excellent garden or container performance
